## Download

Requires **Android 7.1 (API 25) or newer**. Download one APK from **Assets** below:

| APK | Device |
| --- | --- |
| `DubLift-<version>-arm64-v8a-release.apk` | ARM64 (64-bit Android); recommended when supported. |
| `DubLift-<version>-armeabi-v7a-release.apk` | ARMv7 (32-bit Android). |

The filename includes the release version and Android ABI.

Each APK includes DubLift, FFmpeg, and ffprobe. No separate tools are needed.

## Install or update

1. Open the downloaded APK. If Android asks, allow your browser or file manager to install apps.
2. To update, install over your existing release to keep your settings.
3. Open DubLift and allow notifications and the battery-optimization exemption when prompted.

See the [usage and LAN guide](https://github.com/joojoooo/DubLiftApp#-usage)
for Stremio/Nuvio setup and Android background-process limitations.
